notes_for_editor: Tennessee-specific evidence is limited to tnlandforms, the Forest Lookouts Tennessee index, the 2014 extant-tower table and one undated directory entry. The directory's coordinates (36.42759, -85.72224) match the record's (36.4276, -85.7224) to about four decimals, so the record may have been drawn from that directory; check it against tnlandforms. The directory's address and phone come from a commercial listing and are not verified by the Division. Nothing found on build date, design, staffing, fires or current use. The tower is not on the NHLR Tennessee list in the crawl.
